title: One Photograph, Nine Files: Provenance Audit and Sibling-Controlled Evaluation of a Public Fresh and Rotten Fruit Image Dataset (code, splits and results)
description: Code, provenance records, split and design files, predictions and run records for a provenance audit and matched sibling-exposure study of the Kaggle 'Fruits Fresh and Rotten for Classification' collection (six classes). The 13,599 unique images are nine stored versions of 1,511 screen captures, merged into 1,498 capture groups. Version 2.0 adds the matched contamination study (frozen and fine-tuned VGG16, five capture-group splits by two seeds each), the repeated protocol comparison, the re-run of the v1.0 memberships with the documented VGG16 input convention, the embedding-based sibling detection, and a read-only analysis script that regenerates all reported numbers, tables and figures. Version 1.0 materials are kept as historical records. Dataset images are not redistributed.
